name: HURDAT2_processor
what_it_holds: Python script converting NOAA's Atlantic hurricane database (HURDAT2) raw fixed-width text format into a clean pandas dataframe / CSV (storm id, name, date/time, lat/lon, max wind, pressure, per 6-hourly fix).
why_useful: A simple, no-dependency way to get HURDAT2 (the standard official Atlantic-basin storm-track record used by NHC) into an analysis-ready CSV without hand-parsing the NOAA text format, directly supporting Gulf/Atlantic hurricane-season event studies (gap #11).
size_hint: single script + resulting CSV of a few MB
themes: Weather, hurricanes, wildfires, disasters: NOAA/NHC tracks, EM-DAT, FEMA declarations, wildfire perimeters (Maui, LA fires), heatwaves; tourism-shock datasets
why_all: A simple, no-dependency way to get HURDAT2 (the standard official Atlantic-basin storm-track record used by NHC) into an analysis-ready CSV without hand-parsing the NOAA text format, directly supporting Gulf/Atlantic hurricane-season event studies (gap #11).

name: python-aio-georss-gdacs
what_it_holds: Async Python client for the Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (GDACS) GeoRSS feed -- real-time and near-term-historical alerts for earthquakes, tropical cyclones, floods, volcanoes, droughts, and wildfires worldwide, each with a severity/alert-level score.
why_useful: GDACS gives a single cross-hazard, cross-country severity feed (not just US-only like FEMA) -- useful as a lightweight global disaster-shock indicator across APAC/LatAm/EMEA markets that FEMA/NIFC/HURDAT2 don't cover, complementing gap #11 outside the US.
time_coverage: live feed; GDACS itself archives alerts back to the mid-2000s on its own site

name: perimeter
what_it_holds: Coverage/measurement code over California's wildfire perimeter datasets sourced from FRAP (Fire and Resource Assessment Program) and CAL FIRE -- California's own authoritative historical wildfire-perimeter record (predates and complements NIFC/WFIGS).
why_useful: CAL FIRE/FRAP is the longest-running state-level wildfire perimeter archive (decades of California fires) -- useful specifically for the LA and broader California Inside Airbnb markets named in the theme brief.

name: fcdo-travel-advice
what_it_holds: Client/scraper for the UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) travel advice API -- a non-Airbnb-site source for a second country's official travel-advisory levels, complementing the US State Dept series. Updated 2026-09-14 (same day as this scout), so actively maintained.
why_useful: A UK-government advisory series lets a demand-shock construction be cross-checked against a second sovereign source (useful for EMEA-heavy Airbnb markets where UK outbound travelers matter), and diversifies beyond single-source risk in the US State Dept feed.
time_coverage: current/ongoing pull, no stated historical depth
geography: global (countries covered by FCDO advice), UK-outbound perspective
themes: Insurance, safety and travel advisories datasets (State Dept advisories history, travel insurance claims, crime by city) as demand shocks
why_all: A UK-government advisory series lets a demand-shock construction be cross-checked against a second sovereign source (useful for EMEA-heavy Airbnb markets where UK outbound travelers matter), and diversifies beyond single-source risk in the US State Dept feed.
